lines.zh: 我在水底滑行，慢慢往前。
lines.en: I glide along the riverbed, slowly forward.
I push the water aside as I swim.
One twist of my body and I'm off.
The riverbed sand is soft.

lines.zh: 河水的流向替我推着走。
lines.en: The current carries me along.

lines.zh: 岸边的脚步声，我听见了。
lines.en: I hear footsteps on the bank.
I travel along the riverbed to save effort.
The fish scatter away.
My limbs paddle slowly.
I swim into shallower water.
The current pushes me back.
I creep closer to the bank.
I hear someone above the water.
I swim along the shoreline.

lines.zh: 我的影子和水波混在一起。
lines.en: My shadow blends with the ripples.
I bring my face just under the surface.

lines.zh: 我游过一片结冰的水面。
lines.en: I swim under a sheet of ice.
Weed snagged my leg for a moment.

lines.zh: 水从我的裂缝里渗进去。
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams.
Water passes through my seams.
I'm listening to sounds above.
The riverbed is quiet.
I sink a little.
Bubbles rise off me.
I'm waiting for someone to enter the water.
The weeds sway around me.
My gills keep working.
Light comes down through the surface.
My heartbeat is speeding up.
I'm waiting for the blast.
This stretch is mine.
I stay coiled and wait.
I see the sword at your waist.
I can see you.

lines.zh: 水面上那团黑影，是你的。
lines.en: That black shape on the water is yours.
Don't think the water hides me.
Step back, and I'll sink away.
Come a little closer to the edge.
I swim inside your shadow.
Your torch wavers on the water.
Don't stand there.
The water is cold, isn't it.
Your blade cut through the water.
I can't retreat fast in water.
My skin split open.
It hurts, but the water washes it away.
Your blow pushed the water apart.

lines.zh: 火药湿了，我的嘶声变闷。
lines.en: My powder is wet; my hiss turns muffled.
My limbs are in disarray.

lines.zh: 湿火药在水里炸得更狠。
lines.en: Wet gunpowder blows harder underwater.
A string of bubbles rises from my seams.
I've written that into the riverbed.
Food won't lure me away.
I don't eat.
What are you holding up on the bank?
That thing can't reach the riverbed.
I'd rather have you.
Drop it in, and I still won't go.
The smell on your hands is faint.
Don't linger on the bank.
I'm not hungry. I'm just waiting.
You're standing in exactly the right spot.
The aquatic creeper wobbled.
I'm steadier than you in the water.
Your foot slipped.
I pressed against your leg.
The water absorbed the impact.
I slid around you and sank.
Your boot pushed me aside.
The current carried me off course.
Touch me and your clothes are soaked.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，水花溅起。
lines.en: We collided and water splashed up.
There's no other creeper in the water.
Such words don't carry underwater.
We don't meet that way.
I only want to come near the bank.
Don't stand there watching.

lines.zh: 水底很安静，适合一个人。
lines.en: The riverbed is quiet. Good for being alone.
I'm sinking down.
This river is too long, and too cold.
I'll come up one more time.
Then I'm gone.
I can't grip things.
The water will carry it away.
It sank onto me.
I nudge a sunken log aside.
I don't need wet things.
What you drop belongs to the riverbed.
It's stuck in a rock crevice.
I can see it, but can't reach.
Don't throw it in.
Keep it for yourself.
I saw you enter the water.
Now you're mine.

lines.zh: 我在十五格内就能看到。
lines.en: I can see you from fifteen blocks away.
You don't swim fast.
I'm below you.
The water's drag won't help you.
I'm rising.
Can't touch the bottom, can you.
Don't swim back.
Almost there.

lines.zh: 我的引信在水里嘶嘶响。
lines.en: My fuse hisses in the water.

lines.zh: 河里我只有十点血，也够炸。
lines.en: Ten health in the river is enough to blow.

lines.zh: 我的身体在水里几乎看不见。
lines.en: I'm almost invisible in the water.
You looked back — the fuse is lit.
Your stroke is getting sloppy.

lines.zh: 水里的引线，也在嘶嘶响。
lines.en: My fuse hisses even underwater.
The fuse is wet, but it will still go.
You're swimming for the bank.
The bank is farther than you think.
Your strength is draining.
I never bite.
I only need to stay close to you.
Hold still. Just a moment.
I'll count to three.

lines.zh: 我贴住你的小腿，开始发烫。
lines.en: I cling to your calf and start to heat.
The sound under the water is growing.
Swimming won't save you now.
I'm right against you.
River-soaked, my powder is wet.
You can close your eyes.
The riverbed silt swirls where I rise.
A few bubbles broke the surface.
I only spawn in water.
This river suits me.
My shadow is underwater.
No one saw me.
I drift toward the bank.
The weeds part for me.
The world above is too bright.
The fish part, and I rise.

lines.zh: 火在水面上烧，我却在水下。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface. I'm below.
The water caught me. Nothing much.

lines.zh: 我就是水里的东西，淹不死。
lines.en: I'm a thing of the water. I can't drown.

lines.zh: 水把我推得很远，耳里嗡响。
lines.en: The water threw me far, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过水面，扎中我。
lines.en: An arrow pierced the surface and struck me.

lines.zh: 咒语在水里散开，缠上我。
lines.en: The spell spread through the water and caught me.

lines.zh: 水底没什么可吃的，我空着。
lines.en: Little to eat down here. I'm empty.

lines.zh: 闪电顺着水过来，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning came through the water and numbed me.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，我什么都不是。
lines.en: There's no water here. I'm nothing.
